Hi Elena,

Thanks for choosing Redwood for the upcoming PO (98765). To get TideWave set up in our payment rails and ensure remittance visibility for our finance team, can you please send the following by end of day Tuesday (04/13):

- Completed bank authorization form (signed) — we use this for ACH and wire enrollment
- Company W-9 or equivalent tax form
- Bank letter or bank-account verification PDF (letterhead + account number suffix)
- Preferred remittance string and a short CSV example showing how you want invoice/PO mapping handled

For internal alignment, our expected remittance fields are typically: invoice_number | PO_number | vendor_id | remit_description. If TideWave prefers a different format, please include a sample CSV row.

Also include the bank routing details for both ACH and wire (account name, account number, routing/ABA, SWIFT if applicable). If you support immediate micro-deposit verification we can use that method for ACH enrollment — please advise expected micro-deposit amounts and ETA.

We have PO 98765 scheduled for a first disbursement on 2027-04-20; ideally enrollment complete before then. If anything will delay that timeline, flag it and we can coordinate a fallback.

Thanks — attaching our vendor onboarding checklist for reference (no need to resend).
